Name: kind's Mega Modded Community Center Bundles
Author: kindtoeverykind
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q86qPwT.png[/img][/center]

This mod alters the Community Center and abandoned JojaMart bundles to include items from over 20 other mods. I selected the mods based on what I like to use on my own playthroughs. I'm open to making other versions if anyone would like to suggest them!

The Vanilla-Style version requires 1 of most items and has no quality requirements for most of them, while the Challenging version requires 5 of most items and requires high-quality versions of many of them.

I've made two spreadsheets:
One that lists all the bundle requirements and their prizes [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1y8koVvqvWNMMsGG0VDZokTkZBY_yLU3cwayohWVdo2s]here[/url].
And one that lists only the bundle requirements (for if you want the prizes to be a surprise) [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1v91WW4GTi6_VAP3fcHbu8m2H4xVYtXrOFArrcZa0Omc]here[/url].

I tried to make most of the bundle prizes be items that were either useful in completing the other bundles or items that were simply expensive and/or hard to get.

These bundles include items from the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29720]Baubles[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths and Colors[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15333]Copper Still[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - Crops[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - Flowers[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cornucopia - Recipes[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]Dwarven Expansion[/url] (+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22597]Animal Husbandry Mod Patch[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23660]Visit Mount Vapius Patch[/url], & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24317]Everia's Dragons Expanded[/url])[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli and Dylan[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29995]Metalcore Goes Cottagecore[/url], & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url] Add-Ons)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884]Grains Overhull[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9949]Plentiful Harvest[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25467]Si's Extra Crafting Materials[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34843]Camelus[/url])[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] (+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32689]Lani[/url], & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url] Add-Ons)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url][/*]
[/list]I tried to include items that would require players to dig deep into the included mods, so do not expect to finish the Community Center quickly. In fact, this mod makes completing the Community Center more of an end-game goal. Due to the items I've included, this mod also requires:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/172]Recatch Legendary Fish[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17806]Willy and Wizard Heart Events[/url][/*]
[/list]The first one is self-explanatory, and the second one is needed to unlock Ginger Island and the Witch's Swamp when you reach 8 hearts with Willy and the Wizard, respectively. This will enable you to get required items from both of these locations.

The other hard requirements for this mod are:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26998]Completionist's Complete Community Center[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list]CCCC is basically used as a framework on which this mod is based, and Content Patcher is also essential.

Finally, the following mods are not required, but I do recommend them:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31756]Bundles Open Sooner[/url] (makes all of the CC bundles available after completing the first bundle)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28592]Vegas' Item Compatibility Patch[/url] (renames duplicate items from various mods -- these names are the ones I use in this mod's spreadsheets)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30399]Vegas' Oops All Mixed Seeds[/url] (makes mixed seeds contain more different crops, including many modded ones)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17466]Broken Farmhouse[/url] (fix the farmhouse by completing various bundle-like tasks -- gives you another reason to use Si's Crafting Materials, and is just a great mod in general)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies[/url] (gives you more foraging locations)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (makes configuring all your mods so much easier)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] (helps you find information on pretty much anything in the game -- if you get stuck trying to figure out how to get a certain item, then use this mod!)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28261]Machine Control Panel[/url] (allows you to toggle on/off certain machine outputs, which can be essential if you have mods that add different items using the same input to machines)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42725]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/url] (upgrade your tools via completing bundles -- the upgrades happen instantly, so you don't have to spend days without your tool like when you go to Clint)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8630]Walk to the Desert Redux[/url] (makes getting to the desert possible without the bus unlocked)[/*]
[*]Other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] add-ons (they have some great ones!)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9375]Leilani[/url] add-on for Ridgeside Village (brings Keahi's mom back)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url] (they have nothing to do with this mod, but I love them and always recommend them lol)[/*]
[/list]Also, user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mayhay777]mayhay777[/url] posted some more recommendations in the posts tab that are worth checking out! The post is stickyed, so it should be easy to find. :)



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DCZFINl.png[/img][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Download and install all the requirements.[/*]
[*]Download and install either the Vanilla-Style version OR the Challenging version of this mod. DO NOT INSTALL BOTH.[/*]
[*]Start a fresh save and enjoy![/*]
[/list]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VCFHag8.png[/img][/center]

This mod has no configuration options, but you will need to have certain configurations of its requirements for everything to work properly. Mainly, you need to have all the extra content ENABLED and the bundles DISABLED. (Remember that Wildflour's Atelier Goods is configured through Cauldron.)



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/u0BlcBJ.png[/img][/center]

Incompatible:
[list]
[*]Other mods that alter the CC and/or abandoned JojaMart bundles[/*]
[/list]
Compatible:
[list]
[*]All other types of mods[/*]
[/list]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fWuFsmu.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]For this mod, you may use the code as a base for making your own bundle mod. If you can, please send me a link to it when it's complete, because I would probably want to try it out! :)[/*]
[*]Please do not reupload my mods as-is.[/*]
[*]Please do not involve generative AI with my mods.[/*]
[*]Please ask for my permission before uploading alterations or additions to my mods. This does not apply to translations. You do not need to get my permission for translations, but please send me the link so that I can add it to my mod page's description. :)[/*]
[*]Please credit me and link to my original mod if you post an alteration/addition to it.[/*]
[*]Please make my original mod a requirement for any alterations/additions, if possible.[/*]
[*]Please do not lock my mods or any alterations of them/additions to them behind a paywall. They must be provided for free. Also, please only post them on sites/pages that are relatively easy to access (so not, like, a members-only Naver post, for example).[/*]
[*]If I cannot be contacted in any way for over a month, you are allowed to upload alterations or additions to my mods, provided that you follow the other rules that I have specified on that mod's page.[/*]
[/list]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/IMXG1bI.png[/img][/center]

KNOWN ISSUES:
[list]
[*]None![/*]
[/list]
If you encounter any issues, please post them in the Bugs section or the comments section with a LINK to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Do not post the text from the log or a screenshot from the log. This clogs up the page and makes it difficult for me to understand what's going on and help you. If you post the text or a screenshot from the log rather than a link, then I will tell you to provide a log next time and delete your submission.

The only time you are allowed to submit a report/comment about an issue without a link to your SMAPI log is if for some reason you literally cannot get one (such as it being too large to parse). If that is the case, please say so in your report/comment and provide as much detail about the problem as you can. Under these circumstances, pasting text from/including a screenshot of the log may be helpful.
